digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler Jira family adapter mapping seam
propositions: Rebar's reconciler hardcodes Jira project model mappings (status, type, priority, link relations) in multiple locations, preventing support for projects with non-standard workflows without core edits.

A provider-neutral, config-driven mapping seam is needed, layered from built-in defaults → config default block → per-project overlay, to handle status, type, transitions, parent relationships, and required create fields.

Unmapped ticket types must be handled by collapse (via rebar-type: labels), skip (whole-ticket exclusion), or fail-closed validation; non-allowed transitions must attempt replay via STATUS event log or degrade to drift with a warning.
Non-representable parent relationships must drift and emit an echo-safe breadcrumb comment naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key.

The mapping core must remain provider-neutral (no Jira-specific literals), with Jira specifics isolated to the adapter, verified by tests asserting the core contains no Jira imports or hardcoded values.
Live-probe capability detection, suggest-mapping command output, and doctor offline/drift validation must support operator configuration without core edits.
